# Deep Learning 🧠

Neural networks with many layers!

## What you'll learn:
- **Neural Networks** - Basics
- **Activation Functions** - Non-linearity
- **CNNs** - Image processing
- **RNNs** - Sequences

## Deep Learning vs ML

| ML | Deep Learning |
|----|--------------|
| Feature engineering | Automatic features |
| Smaller data | Big data |
| CPU | GPU |
| Interpretable | Black box |

> 💡 **Deep Learning powers ChatGPT, self-driving cars, and image recognition!**

slides.title: Neural Networks
slides.content:
# Neural Network Basics 🔗

## Structure

```
Input Layer → Hidden Layers → Output Layer
    [x]    →    [h1][h2]   →    [y]
```

## Simple Neural Network

```python
import tensorflow as tf
from tensorflow import keras

model = keras.Sequential([
    keras.layers.Dense(128, activation='relu', input_shape=(10,)),
    keras.layers.Dense(64, activation='relu'),
    keras.layers.Dense(1, activation='sigmoid')
])

model.compile(
    optimizer='adam',
    loss='binary_crossentropy',
    metrics=['accuracy']
)

model.fit(X_train, y_train, epochs=10, batch_size=32)
```

## Activation Functions

| Function | Use Case |
|----------|----------|
| ReLU | Hidden layers |
| Sigmoid | Binary output |
| Softmax | Multi-class output |
| Tanh | Hidden layers |

slides.title: CNNs for Images
slides.content:
# Convolutional Neural Networks 📸

Designed for image processing!

## Key Layers

```
Conv2D → Pooling → Conv2D → Pooling → Flatten → Dense
```

## Code Example

```python
model = keras.Sequential([
    keras.layers.Conv2D(32, (3,3), activation='relu', input_shape=(28,28,1)),
    keras.layers.MaxPooling2D((2,2)),
    keras.layers.Conv2D(64, (3,3), activation='relu'),
    keras.layers.MaxPooling2D((2,2)),
    keras.layers.Flatten(),
    keras.layers.Dense(64, activation='relu'),
    keras.layers.Dense(10, activation='softmax')
])
```

## Applications
- 👁️ Image classification
- 🚗 Object detection
- 😊 Face recognition
- 🏥 Medical imaging

slides.title: RNNs for Sequences
slides.content:
# Recurrent Neural Networks 🔄

Process sequences with memory!

## LSTM Example

```python
model = keras.Sequential([
    keras.layers.Embedding(vocab_size, 128),
    keras.layers.LSTM(64, return_sequences=True),
    keras.layers.LSTM(32),
    keras.layers.Dense(1, activation='sigmoid')
])
```

## Applications
- 📝 Text generation
- 🌐 Language translation
- 📈 Time series prediction
- 🎤 Speech recognition

> 💡 **LSTM solves vanishing gradient problem** in basic RNNs!
